seo.title: Dimitris Syrros | Senior Front-end Engineer (React.js, TypeScript)
seo.description: Senior Front-end Engineer specializing in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript and Redux. Building fast, accessible, intuitive web applications.

person.name: Dimitris Syrros
person.tagline: I build fast, accessible interfaces with React.js, Next.js and TypeScript, and I care about performance as much as taste.

photo.alt: Dimitris walking along a winding mountain road under a large orange sun

summary: Results-driven Senior Front-end Engineer with years of hands-on experience in crafting intuitive user interfaces and web application development. Expertise in modern technologies including React.js, Next.js, and Redux, complemented by a deep understanding of the web application development life-cycle. Adept at collaborating closely with product owners, engineers, and diverse teams to drive product excellence. Passionate about optimizing front-end performance, continuous learning, and embracing new challenges to empower users with innovative software solutions.

spotlight: Leading the Redux Form → React Hook Form migration
Spoke at CityJS on the migration
Key engineer on the Dynamic Booking Flow
Tech Team Lead of the new Payments team
experience.story: Started as a developer, now Tech Team Lead of the new Payments frontend team. I’m leading the Redux Form → React Hook Form migration, and told a CityJS meetup how it’s going. I’ve worked extensively on moving the codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript, was a key engineer on the new Dynamic Booking Flow, and built a 3-D Secure flow that makes sure payment failures are handled properly.
experience.role: Senior Frontend Developer – Tech Team Lead
experience.shortRole: Senior Frontend Developer, Tech Team Lead
experience.summary: Tech Team Lead of the new Payments team, and leading the move from Redux Form to React Hook Form across the company.
highlights: Tech Team Lead and founding member of the customer-facing Payments team.

Widened payment coverage with new payment methods, and designed and built a new 3-D Secure flow that enforces proper handling of payment failures. Completed the domain's move to TypeScript, clearing over 61% of its legacy JavaScript, alongside accessibility fixes and higher test coverage.

Leading the migration from Redux Forms to React Hook Form across the codebase, resolving a long-standing performance and maintainability issue affecting multiple teams. Presented the initiative at a CityJS Conference meetup, proudly representing the company.
Playing a key role in building a Dynamic Booking Flow, collaborating with cross-domain teams to align technical solutions with broader business objectives.
Reviewing peer code to uphold high-quality standards, and mentoring junior developers on best practices, code structure, and maintainable frontend development.

spotlight: Reusable components in React and Redux
Agile, side by side with the Product Owner
experience.story: Two years on Eurobank’s e-banking platform and its admin site, building modular, reusable React and Redux components that new features could stand on. I improved the code as I shipped, reviewed my peers’ work, helped new team members find their feet, and worked side by side with the Product Owner from the first development talks onward.
experience.summary: Built modular, reusable React and Redux components for Eurobank’s e-banking platform and its admin website.
experience.description: Worked on Eurobank's e-banking web platform and an associated admin website.
highlights: Prioritized enhanced modularization and heightened component reusability leveraging React.js and Redux.
Pursued code improvements in tandem with feature development.
Conducted peer code reviews for quality assurance and mentored new team members on best practices.
Actively contributed to Agile ceremonies using established methodologies.
Collaborated closely with the Product Owner and Facilitator Team Leader.
Participated in preliminary development talks, facilitating seamless inter-departmental communication.

spotlight: Interfaces for Intralot’s Canvas betting platform
Faster caching and WebSockets in Go and Redis
experience.story: Where it started: interfaces for Intralot’s Canvas, the betting software behind national betting providers around the world. I built front ends in React and Redux with Styled Components and SASS, wrote PHP 7+ APIs on the MVC pattern, and made caching and WebSockets faster with Go and Redis.
experience.summary: Built interfaces for Intralot’s Canvas betting software and tuned its caching and WebSockets with Go and Redis.
experience.description: Integrated and enhanced Intralot's Canvas software for global national betting providers.
highlights: Crafted interfaces utilizing React.js and Redux along with Styled Components and SASS.
Contributed to API development leveraging PHP 7+ and adhering to the MVC design pattern.
Optimized caching and WebSocket mechanisms through Golang and Redis implementations.
experience.note: Took a hiatus for mandatory army service at KEPYES from Jan 2020 to Sep 2020.

experience.company: Centre of Information Technology Support of the Hellenic Army (KEPYES)
experience.summary: Built the admin and client apps of a multi-tenant system used by Greek military hospitals.
experience.description: Worked on a multi-tenant internal project used by Greek military hospitals.
highlights: Developed both admin and client-side platforms using React.js (Redux, Ant Design/Semantic UI, SASS).
Designed and implemented new services with PHP 7+ (Symfony 2).

education.institution: Computer Engineering and Informatics Department (CEID), University of Patras
education.summary: Integrated Master’s in Computer Engineering and Informatics, with a thesis on detecting cyber-bullying using machine learning.

thesis.title: Detecting Cyber-Bullying on Social Networks with Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning
highlights: Employed supervised machine learning techniques, including Naive Bayes, SVM, and Random Forest, to identify and categorize instances of bullying and determine the author's role in user tweets.
Utilized Python, TensorFlow, and Pandas for data processing and algorithm implementation.
